column3: “Arid” renders the image of a weary land.
“Fluently” renders the haste of the stammering tongue.
“Be respected” renders being called an eminent person.
“Sackcloth” supplies what is to be tied around the waist.
“Busy city” renders the city’s tumult as a description of the city.
“Quiet confidence” combines the two expressions for quietness and security.
The Hebrew names a peaceful habitation, secure dwellings, and undisturbed resting places separately.
“Hail will level” makes the hail the explicit cause of the forest’s fall.
“Those” replaces direct address to “you”; “abundant” renders “all,” and the image of the animals’ foot is not retained.
